```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(survival)
```

```{r}
root <- "C://Users/sarah/Documents/CMU/Spring 2026/Systems Synthesis/"
data_dir <- paste0(root,"Data/Matched/")
output_dir <- paste0(root, "Output/")

#Load data files

matched_wide <- read_csv(paste0(data_dir, "matched-within-cohort-grad-non-grad.csv"))
matched_panel <-read_csv(paste0(data_dir, "matched-panel-grad-non-grad.csv"))
```


```{r cars}
#Employment outcome

employment_cl  <- clogit(employment_outcome ~ treatment + any_sentence_before_start + strata(match_pair_id),data = matched_wide, method = "efron")

employment_cl_int  <- clogit(employment_outcome ~ treatment + treatment:cohort_2022 + any_sentence_before_start + strata(match_pair_id),data = matched_wide, method = "efron")

print("Results for Employment Outcome (Any Employment within 1.5 years post-TIP) across all TIP")
summary(employment_cl)

print("Results for Employment Outcome (Any Employment within 1.5 years post-TIP) by cohort")
summary(employment_cl_int)

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
#Offense outcome (for all, not recidivism)

offense_cl  <- clogit(offense_outcome ~ treatment + any_sentence_before_start + strata(match_pair_id),data = matched_wide, method = "efron")

offense_cl_int  <- clogit(offense_outcome ~ treatment + treatment:cohort_2022 + any_sentence_before_start + strata(match_pair_id),data = matched_wide, method = "efron")

print("Results for Offense Outcome (Any Offense within 1.5 years post-TIP) across all TIP")
summary(offense_cl)

print("Results for Employment Outcome (Any Offense within 1.5 years post-TIP) by cohort")
summary(offense_cl_int)
```
```{r}
#Recidivism outcome

potential_recidivism <- matched_wide %>%
  filter(any_sentence_before_start == 1)

recidivism_cl  <- clogit(offense_outcome ~ treatment + strata(match_pair_id),data = matched_wide, method = "efron")

recidivism_cl_int  <- clogit(offense_outcome ~ treatment + treatment:cohort_2022 + strata(match_pair_id),data = matched_wide, method = "efron")

print("Results for Recidivism Outcome (Any Offense within 1.5 years post-TIP) across all TIP participants with previous offense")
summary(recidivism_cl)

print("Results for Recidivism Outcome (Any Offense within 1.5 years post-TIP) by cohort")
summary(recidivism_cl_int)
```
```{r}
#Earnings outcome
matched_panel <- matched_panel %>%
  mutate(
    rel_year = as.integer(year-end_year)
  )

earn <- feols(
  log(earnings_full_year + 1) ~ i(rel_year, treatment, ref = -1) | tip_id + year,
  cluster = ~tip_id,
  data = matched_panel
)

earn_int<- feols(
  log(earnings_full_year + 1) ~ i(rel_year, treatment, cohort_2022, ref = -1) | tip_id + year,
  cluster = ~tip_id,
  data = matched_panel
)

etable(
  earn_int,
  keep_raw = "rel_year::"
)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
